Name: Void's weird Wonders - Simple Foliage retexture (AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
This is a little Alternative Texture retexture of some  the Foliage from[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164] itsanette's Simple Foliage[/url]﻿! I've been meaning to do this for a while already but never really got around to do it and it kinda collected dust in my big, big WIP folder, haha. It's just some weird recolors that kind of fit my bill, Void's Weird Wonders.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and AlternativeTextures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
